hotel_application_versions_routing_compl.name: hotel_application_versions_routing_complete_check
hotel_application_versions_routing_compl.value: ("hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id" is null and "hotel_application_versions"."location_snapshot" is null and "hotel_application_versions"."bureau_organization_id" is null and "hotel_application_versions"."scope_unit_id" is null) or ("hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id" is not null and "hotel_application_versions"."location_snapshot" is not null and "hotel_application_versions"."bureau_organization_id" is not null and "hotel_application_versions"."scope_unit_id" is not null)

hotel_application_versions_routing_consi.name: hotel_application_versions_routing_consistency_check
hotel_application_versions_routing_consi.value: "hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id" is null or ("hotel_application_versions"."scope_unit_id" = "hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id" and jsonb_typeof("hotel_application_versions"."location_snapshot") = 'object' and ("hotel_application_versions"."location_snapshot"->>'id' = "hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id") is true and (not ("hotel_application_versions"."location_snapshot" ? 'administrativeUnitId') or ("hotel_application_versions"."location_snapshot"->>'administrativeUnitId' = "hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id") is true) and ("hotel_application_versions"."content"->>'administrativeUnitId' = "hotel_application_versions"."location_unit_id") is true)

organizations_type_level_check.name: organizations_type_level_check
organizations_type_level_check.value: ("organizations"."organization_type" = 'administrative' and "organizations"."level" in ('federal', 'regional', 'woreda', 'kebele')) or ("organizations"."organization_type" in ('platform', 'provider') and "organizations"."level" is null and "organizations"."administrative_unit_id" is null)
